ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with a low ratio (approx 0.05:0.95) of high-intensity (white) pixels distributed as focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white circular nodes and annular rings distributed sparsely across a continuous low-intensity black matrix, with a slight increase in density toward the lateral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible U-shaped central depression dividing the lobes with an approximate aperture of 85 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge boundary exhibiting high-frequency serrations; distal tips show high-amplitude, irregular macro-serrations and jagged protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep of the trailing edge leading to acute, dorsally-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of high-contrast circular white annular patterns (5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across both lobes, consistent with old attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned high-intensity linear streaks visible on the medial portion of the right lobe, cutting through the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Live calcareous protrusions (barnacle clusters) are visible at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, causing localized distortion of the edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of active epibiont colonization at the lateral margins, presenting as high-relief, textured white clusters against the dark fluke tissue.
